# Amalgamation

↑ **Parent:** [Amalgam](amalgam.md)

Formation of an [amalgam](amalgam.md). The historical report in [The Seats and Causes of Diseases Investigated by Anatomy by Giovanni Battista Morgagni](the-seats-and-causes-of-diseases-investigated-by-anatomy-by-giovanni-battista-morgagni.md) invokes it as a supposed way of reducing a swallowed [silver](silver.md) coin; this does not establish therapeutic efficacy or safety. [Book III, Letter XXX.13](the-seats-and-causes-of-diseases-investigated-by-anatomy-by-giovanni-battista-morgagni.md)
